text:
Jordan: Hey team — noticed 2% increase in OOM rate on the canary fleet after yesterday's allocator tweak (commit a1b2c3). Can someone run a quick memory-profile pass for small-model serving (<1k tokens)?

Priya: Which canary IDs and which workload? I can trigger a repro harness.

Jordan: canary-rls-17 and canary-rls-19. Repro is the smallalloc stress test we use in perf-suite: 10k concurrent reqs, seq_len=512, batch=1. Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/rls-17/2026-03-16

Miguel: Before we start, please dump jemalloc stats and vmmaps. Quick commands:
```
curl -s http://<host>:9000/debug/pprof/heap > heap.pprof
sudo cat /proc/$(pgrep redwood-runtime)/smaps > smaps.txt
LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libjemalloc.so.2 jeprof --text heap.pprof
```
Also set MALLOC_CONF=stats_print:true,background_thread:true,lg_chunk:22 for the run.

Samira: I can run perf-suite on rls-19 now. Which branch should I use? main or the allocator-change branch?

Jordan: allocator-change branch (allocator/rand-chunk) — commit a1b2c3. If you get OOM, capture `journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 200` and a full core if possible.

Niko: In parallel, try toggling background_thread off, and set decay_ms=1 to force faster purging. In my experience that exposes fragmentation bugs quicker:
`MALLOC_CONF=background_thread:false,decay_ms:1`

Laura: We should bisect if Samira reproduces. Priya — can you schedule a bisect job? If it's a regression in the allocator commit range (rev a1b2c3..a1b2c3^), we'll need to roll back quickly.

deploy-bot: Deploy start: allocator/rand-chunk @ a1b2c3 -> canary-rls-19 (2026-03-16T18:42:12Z)

Priya: I'll create perf job and tag issue #3421. Samira, paste the run link here when done.

Samira: Kickoff in 2m. Will post `heap.pprof` + `smaps.txt` here.

Jordan: Thanks all. If anyone hits intermittent OOMs, capture `pmap` and `/proc/<pid>/maps` + `gcore` so we can correlate virtual address holes.

Miguel: FYI I added a small diagnostic to the allocator branch to log large free-list hits. If we see a spike, that'll point at coalescing failures.

Samira: First run shows steady growth -> attaching heap dump: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/runs/181234/heap1.pprof

Jordan: Got it. Taking a look now. I'll post next steps after initial triage.
